name: Airport Memories
steps: Tap the boy’s coat pocket to reveal their first movie ticket.
Tap the girl’s coat to remember the day they first met.
Tap the boy’s thoughts to recall him playing guitar for her.
Tap his breast pocket to find her confession letter.
Tap the matching couple to remember their couple outfits.
Tap the scarf she knitted for him.
Tap her necklace to remember his gift.
Open her suitcase to find the teddy bear from their first date.
